title: Social media blockers too harsh for you?

copy.threads_text:
Social media blockers too harsh for you?

DeRot lets you pick how firm the pause is:

Stay the course: the app stays paused until your reset is done.
Flexible: skip after 10 seconds.
Gentle reminder: a soft nudge, nothing required.

Some days you want a firm hand. Some days a tap on the shoulder is plenty.

images.alt: Three levels of firm Pick the one that fits how you want to feel.
